workflow.gate: each fit test is answered in writing and at least one repeatable page structure is identified

workflow.description: Name the jobs a site is actually hired for in this niche with the observable evidence of each, including the cases where a website is not the owner's real problem
workflow.gate: each job is stated in owner language with evidence a prospect could check on their own site

workflow.action: Write the claims, ownership and conduct charter
workflow.description: Fix what may be claimed and how it is measured, the client's ownership of domain, content and files with its exit path, and the disclosure-first, no-fear-selling conduct rules including extra care for buyers who cannot evaluate the technology
workflow.artifact: standing charter used in every sales document
workflow.gate: no ranking, traffic or revenue guarantee appears anywhere, every claim names its measurement, and the ownership and disclosure rules are written down

workflow.action: Specify the package and the care-plan promise
workflow.description: List the build line items, the explicit not-included list and the add-on menu, then state what the monthly plan promises, its bounded edit allowance and its overflow path
workflow.artifact: package sheet and care-plan promise sheet
workflow.gate: every line names who supplies its input, the not-included list covers the requests that recur in this niche, and nothing is described as unlimited

workflow.action: Derive both prices and choose the split
workflow.description: Build the build-fee floor from measured hours, pass-through costs, rework reserve and overhead share, derive the monthly price from the per-site cost ledger and labour reserve, then choose the split and write the payback in plan-months
workflow.gate: both prices trace to written inputs from the operator's own records and the payback in plan-months is stated

workflow.description: Fix deposit, balance milestone, plan start, cancellation notice and price-change notice in sentences a non-technical owner reads in two minutes, and name the local obligation classes to verify
workflow.gate: each term occupies one plain sentence and no clause exists whose only effect is to make leaving expensive

workflow.description: Build labelled demonstration work or permission-based case studies with before-and-after evidence the named client would confirm, and bring the operator's own site up to the standard being sold
workflow.gate: every item is a permitted real engagement or a visibly labelled demonstration and every stated result is client-confirmable

workflow.description: Work evidence-first direct outreach, the referral ask at its named moments and disclosed partner introductions on a weekly allocation that survives delivery weeks, recording every conversation and every deal's source
workflow.artifact: pipeline record with next actions and sources
workflow.gate: the weekly allocation was honoured during the last build week and every closed deal carries a recorded source

workflow.description: Run the standard intake, recording content ownership and dates, domain, host and email custody as found, the decision-maker and the live job, then check the disqualification signals
workflow.artifact: completed intake record with a fit verdict
workflow.gate: the intake is complete and there is either a fit verdict with a scoping next step or a recorded decline reason

workflow.description: Produce the single proposal-and-scope document with content owners and dates, both prices, the plan start, the ownership pledge and the change-order mechanism, and state the recurring cost aloud before asking for a signature
workflow.artifact: signed scope document held by both parties
workflow.gate: every required section is present, the launch date is conditional on the content dates, and the client holds their own copy

workflow.action: Brief the client and gate the handoff
workflow.description: Set the working rules on channel, response window, consolidated feedback from one decision-maker, review rounds, goodwill allowance and the change-order route, then hand over only a complete package of signed scope, deposit, content inventory, custody facts, plan start and agreed change orders
workflow.artifact: handoff package with a briefing record
workflow.gate: no build starts until every checklist item is supplied or waived in writing and the client can state the working rules

priority_rationale: The frame nodes come first because the unit of sale, the niche, the buying job, the verifiable-claim line, the ownership pledge and the conduct rules constrain every later choice; the offer and economics nodes then turn that frame into a package, a care-plan promise and two prices derived from the operator's own cost ledger; the acquisition nodes can only promise what the offer contains and only prove what was genuinely delivered, so they follow; and the scoping and handoff nodes come last because they are where the frame, the prices and the promises are written into one signed document and gated into delivery.

dominance_rules.rule: Verifiable-claim discipline dominates any pitch that would convert better
dominance_rules.rationale: one guarantee that cannot be kept costs the refund, the client and the reputation of the operator inside a small referral network
dominance_rules.trigger: a prospect asks for a ranking, traffic or lead guarantee, or a draft claim cannot name what it measures
dominance_rules.action: refuse the guarantee, substitute a checkable observation and a measured before-and-after, and let the prospect go if that is their condition of sale

dominance_rules.rule: The client's ownership of their domain, content and files dominates every retention consideration
dominance_rules.rationale: leverage over a client's own assets is both indefensible and the single reputational risk that ends a local business
dominance_rules.trigger: any decision about registrar accounts, access, cancellation terms or handover
dominance_rules.action: keep the assets in the client's name, document the exit path, and hand access over on request without penalty

dominance_rules.rationale: a cost the buyer discovers after signing turns a delivered client into a detractor inside a network of peers
dominance_rules.trigger: a price, a recurring charge, a change-order basis or a partner fee has not been said plainly
dominance_rules.action: state it before the signature is requested, put it in writing, and confirm the buyer can repeat it back

dominance_rules.rule: The derived cost floor dominates the urge to rescue a slow month
dominance_rules.rationale: work sold below its floor consumes the capacity that would otherwise have served a real deal
dominance_rules.trigger: a quote would fall below the floor
dominance_rules.action: reduce scope instead of price or decline, with the only exception a disclosed, time-bounded founding arrangement that buys a reference and still covers pass-through cost

dominance_rules.rule: The signed scope dominates every later verbal recollection
dominance_rules.rationale: memories diverge under pressure and the document is the only thing both parties can read the same way
dominance_rules.trigger: a disagreement about what was included
dominance_rules.action: read the relevant line together and route anything outside it through a change order

dominance_rules.rationale: an unlimited promise prices an unknown and is broken the first time a client tests it
dominance_rules.trigger: a package or plan feature is about to be described as unlimited, guaranteed or free
dominance_rules.action: replace it with a stated allowance, a definition of what counts, and the overflow path

dominance_rules.rule: Care for a buyer who cannot evaluate the offer dominates closing the sale
dominance_rules.rationale: a signature obtained through confusion is worthless commercially and indefensible ethically
dominance_rules.trigger: the buyer cannot restate what recurs monthly, is buying in a second language, is unassisted and unfamiliar with the technology, or has just been burned by a previous vendor
dominance_rules.action: slow down, put it in plain writing, invite a second reader, and require the buyer's own restatement before any signature

dominance_rules.rule: Delivery capacity dominates the temptation to sell one more build
dominance_rules.rationale: the referral loop that feeds this business is fed by delivered work, and late launches close whole networks at once
dominance_rules.trigger: accepting a new build would exceed the stated concurrent-build limit
dominance_rules.action: book it to a later start date rather than squeezing it into the current window

dominance_rules.rule: The handoff gate dominates the client's impatience to start
dominance_rules.rationale: an item discovered before the build costs minutes while the same item discovered mid-build costs days and a moved launch
dominance_rules.trigger: any handoff checklist item is missing when a build is due to start
dominance_rules.action: hold the project in a named waiting state with the specific missing item visible to the client

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the deliverable inventory before deriving any price
anti_rework_rules.prevents: pricing a package whose contents keep moving, which forces every quote and every add-on to be re-derived

anti_rework_rules.rule: Define what the care plan promises before quoting a monthly figure for it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a monthly fee that never carried the labour reserve for work already promised, discovered only when the edits start arriving

anti_rework_rules.rule: Ask who owns the domain and where business email lives in the first intake conversation
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering at launch that nobody can reach the registrar, which strands a promised date and risks breaking a working mailbox

anti_rework_rules.rule: Name the content owner and the date for every page before the build starts
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a build that stalls half-finished and has to be rescheduled around content that was never anybody's job

anti_rework_rules.rule: State the recurring cost aloud before requesting a signature
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a first monthly invoice that turns a delivered client into a refund conversation and a lost reference

anti_rework_rules.rule: Put the not-included list in the proposal rather than into the mid-build conversation
anti_rework_rules.prevents: arguing about online payments, logo design or extra pages while the build is already half done

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write a change order before doing an out-of-scope favour, even when the price is zero
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a precedent that silently redefines both the package and what the client believes the care plan includes

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record every deal's source from the first prospect onward
anti_rework_rules.prevents: months of effort poured into a channel that never produced a client, and a niche decision re-made on impressions instead of evidence

anti_rework_rules.rule: Hold the weekly prospecting allocation during delivery weeks
anti_rework_rules.prevents: the empty-pipeline gap that follows every busy build month and the panic discounting that gap produces

iteration_protocol.trigger: the same out-of-package request appears on several consecutive deals
iteration_protocol.action: decide deliberately whether it becomes a priced add-on with its own measured cost, enters the standard package with a re-derived floor, or is stated earlier as an exclusion

iteration_protocol.trigger: measured build hours, pass-through costs or per-site support minutes move materially
iteration_protocol.action: re-derive the affected floor or monthly price, then re-check the payback and the current open quotes against the new figures

iteration_protocol.trigger: a cohort of clients cancels earlier than the payback the split assumed
iteration_protocol.action: re-read the split, the deposit and the plan promise against observed client life, and record the actual retention in place of the assumed one

iteration_protocol.trigger: conversion in the chosen niche stalls across a full outreach cycle or the referral network goes quiet
iteration_protocol.action: re-read the niche decision on recorded per-channel and per-trade evidence before changing anything about the offer itself

iteration_protocol.trigger: a client repeats back an outcome expectation nobody promised
iteration_protocol.action: trace where it entered, whether the proposal, a portfolio item, an outreach message or the briefing, repair that document, and restate the limits to the client

iteration_protocol.trigger: a project goes wrong for a reason the intake never asked about
iteration_protocol.action: add the missing question to the standard intake and the missing item to the handoff checklist

iteration_protocol.trigger: a jurisdictional rule on contracts, cancellation, recurring billing or unsolicited commercial contact changes
iteration_protocol.action: verify the current rule locally, then revise the terms sheet and the outreach practice to match before the next deal

iteration_protocol.trigger: a case-study permission is withdrawn or a portfolio item drifts out of date
iteration_protocol.action: remove or replace the item and re-check that every remaining claim is still one the named client would confirm
